mostWorthwhile.text: Filtering the blood and then recovering glucose made the distinction between filtration and selective reabsorption clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the ureters and bladder was straightforward but repetitive, since the named slots already indicated the pairings.

surprise.text: The filter lets many small substances enter the tubule before useful substances are selectively recovered; almost all filtered glucose is normally recovered in healthy kidneys.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the water-recovery picture shows water returning to blood without explaining what drives its movement.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter: connecting a microscopic process to an organ system was useful, though I would hope for more explanation of mechanisms and more meaningful choices.
